messages:
Maya Patel: We're confirmed for the Civic Hack Night next Tue 6pm-11pm. Booth is a compact 6ft table in the main hall. Need a short runbook: staffing rota, swag counts + shipping, demo laptop + AV, and handling of the two lightning talk slots we submitted. Can owners chime in with quick items we should lock down?

Liam Chen: Swag inventory quick check — stickers 200, t-shirts 50 (mix S-XL), postcards 100. I can ship from SF office. What's the ship-by date? :truck:

Aria Gomez: I'll make a volunteer rota. Proposing 3 shifts: 5:30-7, 7-9, 9-11. Spreadsheet up: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/meetup-volunteers. Please add your name and preferred shift. :raising_hand:

Samir Rao: For the lightning talks — conference accepted 2x 10-min slots. We need a slide template + speaker blurb. I'll PR a slide deck template to the marketing drive by EOD: https://drive.redwood/team/marketing/templates/llm-talk.pptx

Anita Brooks: AV check: compact table => bring 1x HDMI adapter, 1x Mac->HDMI dongle, small Bluetooth speaker for demos, label printer. Does venue have a mic? If not we'll ask for lapel mic or use phone recorder as backup.

Liam Chen: Shipping plan: I can courier swag Fri AM (expedited) — ETA Mon. Cost estimate $65. Need Maya to approve budget and confirm recipient name at venue. Tracker: https://redwood.internal/ship/1234

Maya Patel: Approved for $65. Ship to: Civic Community Center — Receiving, Attn: Events desk (they hold packages). Please drop tracking in the sheet when booked.

Aria Gomez: Volunteer rota updated with names and roles (demo, lead capture, talk stage hand): https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/meetup-volunteers — added emoji reactions column for confirmations. Please react when you're locked in. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Civic Hack Night — Redwood Booth" Tue 18:00-23:00 (invites sent to marketing+solutions).

Samir Rao: Packing checklist (small):
```
- 6ft tablecloth (branded)
- 2x laptops (demo + backup)
- HDMI dongles + adapters
- power strip + 6ft extension
- charging hub (USB-C)
- swag: stickers, tees, postcards
- business cards + lead QR printouts
- label printer + tape
- slide deck on USB + cloud link
```

Anita Brooks: Quick Q on power: venue says 1 outlet near our table, we should bring extension AND power brick hub. Also I'll bring a small UPS for the demo laptop.

Maya Patel: Who can man the demo around 8:30pm? Need someone confident with the model and a short 5-min walkthrough. @Samir Rao @Liam Chen

Samir Rao: I can cover 8:30-9:00 demo slot and will prep a 5-min live prompt flow and 1 backup recording.

Liam Chen: I'll take 6:00-7:30 (setup + early traffic) and bring extra charging hub. Also I can pick up the label printer from office on Fri.

Maya Patel: Awesome — sounds covered. Final items: Samir upload final slides to drive by Mon AM, Liam drop tracking and ship Fri, Anita bring AV + UPS, Aria confirm volunteer reactions by EOD Mon. I'll create a 1-page runbook (setup, teardown, emergency contacts) and post it here when done. :rocket:
